method: python training/confirm_tv.py --amazon-dir amazon-movies-tv MovieLens has no TV, so this uses the Movies_and_TV part of Amazon Reviews 2023 (McAuley Lab, UCSD; 17.3M ratings from 6.5M people, 1996 to Sep 2023, released for research). Each product is either a show (a TV category or "Season"/"Series" in its title; all seasons of a show count as one show) or a movie, matched to iCinema's MovieLens movies by title. A 4 or 5 star rating is a "loved." "Fans like you" is item-kNN, the same cosine-with-shrink model iCinema uses for movies.
